title: Knob: Stage 7 mode-stability early-exit (#120)
description: Read by process_governance/stage7_run.py (load_mode_stability). `enabled` is the operational kill-switch the Settings toggle may flip (it also stamps toggled_by/toggled_at); the numeric params are methodology, changed by PR. Renaming a param key without updating stage7_run.py silently degrades to the defaults — this schema converts that into a suite failure.
